difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the cohomology sheaf of a termwise inverse limit of complexes: under a covering family B of objects on which R^1 lim vanishes in the relevant degrees and the cohomology stabilises for n >= n_0, the maps H^m(F^bullet) -> lim H^m(F_n^bullet) -> H^m(F_{n_0}^bullet) are isomorphisms of sheaves (statement lines 5616-5642). The proof must combine three different hypotheses in the right order: the degree bookkeeping that produces the complex of limits at a single object (proof lines 5645-5652), the inverse-limit criterion applied to the two lower degrees and to H^{m-1} (proof lines 5653-5659), and finally sheafification together with the covering condition on B, which is what upgrades a pointwise computation on B to an isomorphism of sheaves (proof lines 5664-5669). The claim is H2: one carefully ordered application of a limit criterion plus a sheafification step.
